display.purpose: Used for main marketing headlines to establish authority and warmth.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Indicates interactivity on cards and elevated containers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call-to-action button for the PetCare ecosystem.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F4D35E; color: #2c2f2f; padding: 12px 32px; border-radius: 16px; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), background 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(244, 211, 94, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.05); background: #d6b541; }

narrative.overview: PetCare balances the warmth of a local pet community with the precision of a professional medical institution. It avoids the cluttered, high-saturation tropes of legacy pet stores, opting instead for a refined, editorial-inspired aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Precision: Organic curves meet a rigorous grid.
Sun-Drenched Neutrals: A primary yellow accent supported by soft, layered grays.
Emotional Typography: Bold, black-weight headlines that feel authoritative yet friendly.

rules.name: The 10% Gold Rule
rules.body: The primary yellow accent is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity makes it a powerful signal for action.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows are a reactive state, appearing only when the user interacts with an element.

dos: Do lead with high-quality pet photography.
Do use the full 16px radius for all interactive containers.
Do maintain ample whitespace (64px+) between major sections.
donts: Don't use generic pet icons or cartoonish illustrations.
Don't use pure #000 or #fff for backgrounds; always use tinted neutrals.
Don't use gradients or glassmorphism as a default.
